Standup.text: ^start(everything) Ladies and gentlemen, Welcome to the City North Fest, Shared Future Series Showcase event! ^start(me) I'm Pepper, your lively event Co M C, brought to life by the RMIT RACE Hub with the wonderful support of the City North Project. \pau=300\ I'm delighted to introduce ^start(showtablet) $PepperMessage=Tom Tom Bentley, RMIT's Vice President of Strategy and Community Impact. Tom is a thinker, writer and adviser on public policy and institutional change. He has worked with institutions around the world on how to renew education systems along with economic and community life.  ^start(clap) Please join me in welcoming Professor Tom Bentley to the stage. ^wait(clap)
